import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/inspections/%7Binspection_id%7D/item_references?filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bitem_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

data = res.read()
